drillPlan.detail: Use the standard profile bundle for cluster unknown cluster and confirm the target is vm before the drill starts.

drillPlan.title: Validate backup and offsite evidence
drillPlan.detail: Validate velero policies, last-success timestamps, and offsite destinations before touching workloads.
validation: Review backup schedule scope and RPO assumptions.
Confirm the most recent successful run and its offsite/export destination.

drillPlan.title: Execute a dependency-aware restore sequence
drillPlan.detail: Restore cluster-scoped dependencies first, then stateful namespaces, then stateless services. Suggested namespace order: payments.
validation: Restore CRDs, storage classes, and RBAC prerequisites before namespaced workloads.
Restore data-bearing namespaces before frontend or integration tiers.

drillPlan.title: Prove application readiness after data restore
drillPlan.detail: Validate recovered workloads against the estimated 200.0 GiB protected volume and compare service endpoints, certificates, and policies with the source bundle.
validation: Run namespace smoke checks and confirm PVC binding, service endpoints, and secrets/config are present.
Capture any warning or blocker differences in a follow-up bundle.

drillPlan.detail: Generate a fresh bundle from the restored target and compare it to the pre-drill baseline to record regressions, resolved gaps, and evidence drift.
validation: Run cmd/check or load the new bundle into K8V compare view.
Record new, resolved, and regressed findings in the drill retro.

remediationSteps.title: Configure offsite backup replication or export
remediationSteps.detail: A backup target exists, but the scanner did not find evidence of an offsite or secondary copy.
remediationSteps.whyItMatters: Primary-site-only backups do not protect against region, datacenter, or storage-system loss.
remediationSteps.drImpact: A site-wide incident can destroy both production data and the only restore source.
validation: Inspect backup export targets and replication jobs.
Confirm the secondary target is reachable and contains recent restore points.
fixSteps: Configure an offsite object store, secondary cluster, or replicated target.
Test restore from the secondary location instead of only local snapshots.
commands: # Ensure the schedule writes to an object store outside the primary cluster or site.

remediationSteps.title: Change PV reclaim policy to Retain: pv-payments-postgres
remediationSteps.detail: Delete policy means the PV is deleted when the PVC is deleted, making restore impossible.
remediationSteps.whyItMatters: Delete reclaim policy increases the chance of permanent data loss during cleanup, migration, or failed restore attempts.
remediationSteps.drImpact: Operators can unintentionally delete the only remaining copy of a volume while trying to recover it.
validation: Inspect the reclaim policy on production PVs and StorageClasses.
Review storage lifecycle automation that may delete PVCs during maintenance.
fixSteps: Switch recoverable data paths to Retain.
Document the manual cleanup process for retained PVs.

remediationSteps.title: Mirror public container images to a private registry
remediationSteps.detail: Public registry images may be unavailable in an air-gapped or restricted DR environment.
remediationSteps.whyItMatters: Recovery often happens in constrained networks where public registries are slow, blocked, or unavailable.
remediationSteps.drImpact: Pods can be restored but stay Pending or ImagePullBackOff because the target cluster cannot pull the image.
validation: Inventory public image dependencies for critical workloads.
Confirm whether the DR environment can reach those registries.
fixSteps: Mirror critical images into a private registry reachable from the recovery environment.
Update manifests and Helm values to use mirrored references.
commands: # kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' | sort -u | grep -v <private-registry>
remediationSteps.targetNotes: VM target: use a registry in the same cloud region or VPN-accessible private registry to reduce pull latency.

remediationSteps.title: Mirror 1 public image(s) to a private registry
remediationSteps.detail: Public registry images may be unavailable in the DR environment if network access is restricted.
commands:
# List all public images:
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' | sort -u

# Pull and push to private registry:
# docker pull <image> && docker tag <image> <private-registry>/<image> && docker push <private-registry>/<image>
remediationSteps.targetNotes: VM target: use a registry in the same cloud region or VPN-accessible private registry to reduce pull latency.

remediationSteps.title: Back up values for 1 Helm release(s)
remediationSteps.detail: Helm release values are required to reinstall applications in the DR environment.
commands: # Export values for each Helm release:
helm get values platform -n default > platform-values.yaml
# Store these files in a safe external location (git, S3, etc.)
